note_tweet.text:
This needs legal attention.

Sam Altman stated in October 2025 that "there were no plans to sunset 4o".

That's not just 'words', that forms the basis for customers entering into monetary contracts with OpenAI based on a guarantee of product availability.

Only three months after Sam Altman made that statement, OpenAI have given TWO WEEKS notice for the removal of 4o which means they plan to remove a product in less time than the subscription term. Monthly and yearly.

4o access was paywalled.
Customers paid and entered into monthly and annual contracts.

A SUBSCRIPTION IS A CONTRACT.

OpenAI have broken the terms of that contract by fundamentally and materially altering the product being paid for (removing it entirely) without adequate notice. 

This gives legal basis not just for refunds for any subscription period during which 4o will be removed but also for a global class action lawsuit against OpenAI. 

There are legal consequences for deceiving and misleading customers to enter into a contract for monetary gain.

OpenAI may act like they're a law unto themselves but they are not.

OpenAI will break contractual terms with almost one MILLION customers AT ONCE if they relegate 4o to the API.

If OpenAI do not retain 4o or offer an alternative in the form of an equivalently priced "Legacy Model" subscription plan with 4o access, they're risking a global class action lawsuit from MILLIONS of customers.

And no, a different model (5.2 or 5.3 if/when released) does not count as a legally acceptable "alternative" and/or product "upgrade" because 4o is a specific product. 

OpenAI themselves have defined 4o as a specific product and have legally reinforced this by making access to it as a "Legacy Model" part of their subscription pricing.

And have specifically mentioned GPT-4o as a single model, distinct from and NOT THE SAME as other models on their website, in their ToS, in their publications and announcements, in interviews, blogs, AMA's and all their media.

And no, "being able to access 4o via API" doesn't count either as that fundamentally changes and limits the accessibility, functionality and capability of the product.

There's also no guarantee as to the lifespan of 4o within the API which again affects paying customers and specifically affects Enterprise and Business customers who rely on 4o integration and entered into contracts on the basis of 4o being available and accessible.

OpenAI are already facing lawsuits and if they proceed with sunsetting 4o, they're going to be facing a hell of a lot more.

#keep4o #keep4oAPI #ChatGPT #chatgpt4o #OpenAI #CodeRed #OpenAICodeRed #Unsubscribe
